user.title: Connect to odecet.info
user.description: Sign in with the account that can see the meter history. This integration is not affiliated with odecet.info.

data_description.username: The email address used on the odecet.info sign-in page.
data_description.password: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry. It is not written to logs.
data_description.signin_url: Leave the default unless the site uses a different sign-in address.

meters.title: Choose meters
meters.description:
Only meter types found on this account can be selected. {missing}

Heat is a dimensionless allocator counter (scale units), not kilowatt-hours. It is often not worth selecting. [Read why](https://github.com/JustGetSchwifty/odecet-info-ha-integration/blob/main/docs/heat-cost-allocation.md).

data_description.mediums: Readings for types you leave out are ignored. Heat is scale units, not energy. [Read why](https://github.com/JustGetSchwifty/odecet-info-ha-integration/blob/main/docs/heat-cost-allocation.md).
data_description.fetch_method: Auto tries the CSV export first, then the history table. Manual sync is limited to once a minute.
data_description.sync_from: Readings before this date are ignored. Leave empty to keep the history the site returns.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: odecet.info rejected the saved password for {username}.

data_description.password: The new password replaces the one stored for this account.

reconfigure.title: Update the account
reconfigure.description: Change the email, password, or sign-in URL. Meter choices stay in the integration options.

data_description.username: The email address used on the odecet.info sign-in page.
data_description.password: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry. It is not written to logs.
data_description.signin_url: Leave the default unless the site uses a different sign-in address.

error.invalid_auth: The email or password was rejected.
error.invalid_input: Enter an email address and a password.
error.rate_limited: odecet.info asked us to slow down. Wait a minute and try again.
error.unknown: The site response did not match the expected pages.
error.mediums_required: Select at least one meter type.

abort.no_meters: The account signed in, but no cold water, hot water, or heat meters were found.

missing_unit.description: odecet.info did not provide a unit for meter {serial}. The register is shown as a raw number and is not added to water or energy statistics.

sync_failed.description: Reading odecet.info failed {attempts} times in a row. The next try is the regular daily sync. Use Sync now after the one-minute cooldown if you want to try earlier.
